summary: MiMo-V2 audio input works without torchaudio, with identical features
compatibility: No user action required. Deployments with torchaudio installed are unchanged.
details: Images without a matching torchaudio wheel rejected every MiMo audio request: the media parser's default resampler and the MiMo processor's mel spectrogram both required torchaudio.

Plain-PyTorch ports of torchaudio's default Resample and MelSpectrogram now serve when torchaudio is missing; they are bitwise identical to torchaudio (tests compare with torch.equal when torchaudio is present and pin reference values when it is not).
